name: Wondering
long_description:
Wondering turns anything you want to learn, from LLMs to quantum mechanics to product design, into a path of three-minute lessons with visuals, podcasts, and interactive exercises. 

Each learning path and its content are personalized to your background, how you learn best, and how deep you want to go.

It’s the most delightful way to understand complex topics and turn information into knowledge you can remember and apply. You don’t just passively read. You practice, make connections, and form your own insights.

Start learning anything for free at https://wondering.app/download

launches.title: Wondering - Duolingo for learning anything
launches.tagline: Break down any complex topic into a personalized path of short interactive lessons
launches.body:
Wondering is the most delightful way to understand complex topics and turn information into knowledge you can remember and apply.

Tell it what you want to learn, from[ LLMs](https://wondering.app/learn/attention-is-all-you-need-zp2vvu) to[ Analytic Philosophy](https://wondering.app/learn/tractatus-logico-philosophicus-qfmwam), and it creates a structured path of short lessons with visuals, podcasts, and interactive exercises, personalized to what you already know and how deep you want to go.

Each lesson surfaces the most important ideas and lets you customize how you explore them, like a thoughtful tutor beside you.

Check out our[ launch video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uZ72r5-B3UM) for a closer look.

Wondering has helped **more than 12k people complete over 42k lessons**, with 687 learning with us this past week and **100+ paying**. Start learning anything for free at[ https://wondering.app](https://wondering.app)

**About the team**

We're Cheng-Wei (ex-NotebookLM) and Angelica (ex-Meta). We met at Cornell Tech over a shared passion for education and have been building together for 5+ years.

**Our asks**

* Give Wondering a try and let us know what you think[ https://wondering.app](https://wondering.app)
* If there’s a group or organization you’d like to teach with Wondering, write to us at [founders@wondering.app](mailto:founders@wondering.app).
